close_reason: Merged into JMAP-78lb per user instruction 2026-05-09. Both beads concerned the same line (crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:231); splitting would have meant editing it twice. JMAP-78lb's description now covers both the value-type and the key-type fix as a single coordinated change.
description:
Cross-cutting key-type fix surfaced during the JMAP-trmz survey.

File: crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:231

  // Currently
  pub on_success_update_email: Option<HashMap<String, Value>>,
  // After (combined with sibling JMAP-78lb's value-type fix)
  pub on_success_update_email: Option<HashMap<jmap_types::Id, jmap_types::PatchObject>>,

Cookie-cutter rationale: the canonical client-side parallel field
crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/submission.rs::EmailSubmissionSetParams::on_success_update_email
is already typed as HashMap<Id, PatchObject>. Mail-types is the canonical extension-types
template; its types should match the canonical client-side shape unless the spec mandates
otherwise. RFC 8621 §7.4 specifies the keys as Email IDs (typed Id, not bare String).

Wire format unchanged (Id is #[serde(transparent)] over String).

## Coordination

This change should land in the SAME commit as JMAP-78lb (the value-type fix on the same field).
Splitting them would mean editing line 231 twice. JMAP-78lb's notes should be updated to mention
this coupling.

## Acceptance criteria

cargo test --workspace clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical.
title: Fix MdnSendRequest::on_success_update_email key type: String → Id (cookie-cutter)
